svg.aria-label: Four stages. 1, initial state: unit 1 holds P1, P2 and P3, unit 2 holds P4, P5 and P6, unit 3 holds P7, P8 and P9. 2, scale out: an empty unit 4 is added. 3, partition rebalancing: P3 moves from unit 1, P6 from unit 2 and P9 from unit 3 to unit 4. 4, rebalanced state: unit 1 holds P1 and P2, unit 2 holds P4 and P5, unit 3 holds P7 and P8, unit 4 holds P3, P6 and P9, so data is evenly distributed and the system can handle more traffic
svg.text: A new processing unit joins the grid and takes over some partitions, so data is spread evenly again.
Three units store partitions of the data.
A new unit is added to handle more data
Partitions are moved from existing units
Data is evenly distributed across all units.
The system can now handle more traffic.
